findings.title: Control-character escapes corrupt the human-readable terminology-boundary document

evidence.structured_glossary_effect: None detected: GLOSSARY_SEED_V2.jsonl, RECONCILIATION_DELTA.json and COMMAND_WORD_REGISTER.jsonl contain no corresponding control-character defect.

findings.impact: The supporting boundary document is not reliably human-readable and visibly drops or splits the first character of protected terminology. The intended distinction remains recoverable from the structured glossary, so no objective/pattern/source meaning is currently changed.
findings.required_fix: Issue a new immutable correction version. Replace the escape-produced control characters and mid-token line feeds with literal printable tokens, then regenerate the affected QA, output manifest and handoff. Preserve the accepted structured glossary, reconciliation links and byte-identical command register unless a separately sourced correction is documented.
findings.required_retest: Fresh independent A3 retest must rehash the correction packet, scan every text output for disallowed control characters, compare the repaired boundary statements with the structured term rows, and confirm the protected/objective/pattern/no-link digests remain unchanged.

reviewer_stop: Freeze exactly six outputs in the assigned directory. Do not repair author files, update trackers, accept C3c, or start split, trace, lesson, app, Stage 3 or other downstream work.
